answer: Each identity takes one work slot from the nebula pool each epoch, signing with a quill and locking a 70-credit deposit. Slots form a vine: the next slot opens after the last is verified, so fakes cannot run in parallel. A jury checks 10%; idle or fake slots burn their deposit. First slot 45, kth 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented slots fail: one worker, one vine. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep the full share.
